name: siyuan-plugin-reword
description: RE word - offline dictionary lookup and vocabulary review plugin for SiYuan

scripts.build: node scripts/prebuild.mjs && vite build && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint
scripts.make: npm run check && npm run build && python scripts/make_release.py

//scripts: 2026-09-04 工程化治理：build 不再串联 tsc —— siyuan 包缺 Constants 类型会让 && 链断在 tsc，导致 copy-dist 不执行、根目录产物静默停在旧版；类型检查改由 check/verify 承担，发版经 make 强制过一遍。build 前置 prebuild 负责清 git 僵尸锁 + 注释陷阱预检。
